overall: The AG found a violation for failing to record the posting date and time on the original Nov. 7, 2012 notice, but no violation for late topic additions, the scheduling topic, or distributing the revised notice.

allegations.summary: Commission revised its Nov. 7, 2012 meeting notice without recording on the notice when the revisions were posted.
allegations.key_passage: Accordingly, this office finds that the Commission violated the Open Meeting Law by failing to record the date and time the notice was posted on or with the Original Notice of its November 7, 2012 meeting.

allegations.summary: Commission discussed matters at its Nov. 7, 2012 meeting that were not listed on the notice posted 48 hours in advance.
allegations.key_passage: Accordingly, it was not unlawful for the Commission to discuss the topic during its November 7, 2012 meeting.

allegations.summary: Commission added a scheduling topic to the notice less than 48 hours before the meeting and distributed the revised notice to members.
allegations.key_passage: Furthermore, because distribution of a meeting agenda is not deliberation, the Commission did not violate the Open Meeting Law by distributing a revised notice with the additional scheduling topic.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law.
remedy_passage: We order immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law.
note: Read by a language model from the letter; every key passage is checked verbatim against it and dropped if not. A holding is the Attorney General’s reading of the law in this case only.
